title: Ghosts of Denver Family Friendly Walking Tour
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Get ready for a spooky, family-friendly adventure on The Ghosts of Denver tour, where history and hauntings come together! Perfect for history lovers and thrill-seekers alike, this tour dives deep into the real stories behind Denver’s most haunted homes and Victorian mansions.

Led by expert guides, you’ll uncover the fascinating—and sometimes eerie—truths about the ghosts and people that still haunt these historic sites. They say the truth is spookier than fiction... and we’re about to prove it! 

If you have 10 or more guests in one group, please contact the private & group sales coordinator with Ghost City Tours.
